Cleanly formatted résumés in your pocket ready to go. This app is NOT for designers and graphic artists who need to show of their skills with their résumé's originality. Instead, this app is for those of us in fields where a future potential employer needs to read and absorb your education and experience cleanly and quickly, for those who literally don't have the time to create proper design and formatting in a word processing app, such as those in medical fields. Some reviewers complain about lack of customization, but that is incorrect: there is a high level of customization as to what information is provided, and some customization to the formatting, but little customization to the overall layout and colors. Therefore, this app is perfect for those who need a clean professional résumé quickly, and to be able to make updates quickly without worrying about cutting&pasting the proper formatting. This update adds the ability to add a photo, and that is one feature I was hoping would be added.
WISH LIST: 1. Be able to change the color of the section header text(or the horizontal lines) 2. Use on iPad in PORTRAIT mode also.
